items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So finally, he would play with this Jameson guy, and I would too

ctx.x: can play a horn, and I said I can too. So he said we got to get together then and I said yeah. It was in the summertime then, and hot and the wiring, crawling up into the attic on the job and he said, man, I think I can get you something better than this. So I said what. He said I was playing with the Missourians, and they have told me that a guy has brought in (inaudible); an entertainer, a vocalist, that is a terrific showman and they have money behind them, and says they're going to call me. He said will you…

So we would play all around and we would run over to Muskogee sometimes and play a gig and he said you sure got to find out about getting this job. So finally, he would play with this Jameson guy, and I would too, and he finally told Jameson--but he was doing carpenter work--he finally gets his call from way up in Missouri, Kansas and told them to
come, which for that day and time, I think they were guaranteed fifty dollars a week and might have had a chance to make more.
